noteOps.text: PLAUSIBLE at 62159bc1: MED; the code defect reproduces under every refusing model; which experience a player gets is a model result, not a device result. iPhone (volume locked): the day track can start at boot at full system volume, plays through every night, and Mute All and the music slider cannot silence it. Current iPad: the fade-up from 0 outside a gesture pauses the track, so music never starts (if the mp3 has loaded by the first fade tick). Older iOS: silent until a music control is touched, then tracks pile up and mute does nothing. Desktop Chrome at low engagement: no music for day 1. On iPhone the boot play() may be allowed. Fixed in code by lane L10, PR #70 (DECISIONS 2026-10-31 item 301): each track through createMediaElementSource and its own GainNode to the destination (the mix unchanged), a refused play() retried inside the next gesture, the other tracks primed there, Mute All pausing by state; tests/gates/apple-audio-gates.test.jsx and tests/e2e/music-bus.spec.js. The device checks (an iPhone and an iPad on the live site: listen 30 s after Start, play past dusk, toggle Mute All, with Web Inspector logging each play() promise, paused and volume; and a fresh-profile desktop Chromium run) moved to REVIEW:l1:ios-device-run, Kevin's.

Lane L10: play, press Home for 10 s and come back, then swing and place a block and hear both with no reload; the same after a call and after Siri; with Web Inspector, log the AudioContext state and whether currentTime advances after the return. The soundtrack: within a few seconds of Start the day track plays; the music slider moves it; Mute All silences it within a second and unmuting brings it back; past dusk the night track takes over with no tap. By ear (DECISIONS 2026-10-31 item 301): on a fresh desktop Chrome profile, whether the title music starts at load or at the first click or key; on an iPhone, whether the ring/silent switch silences the music; the day-to-night crossfade, now a continuous ramp; and on an iPhone the soundtrack against the effects, about 8 dB quieter, since it now plays at 0.4 x the slider where WebKit's locked volume played it at full.

noteOps.text: Seen as tests/e2e/music-bus.spec.js's page no longer answering on two of three CI runs when it entered from the title's Start Adventure. Round 1 held two hypotheses: (a) the entry, a trusted click on Start Adventure entering play outside _boot.js's startPlayActive, and (b) the music route through createMediaElementSource. Round 2 (DECISIONS 2026-10-31 item 306) refuted (b): with MusicPlayer making no track and no gesture callback the page stopped answering at least as often (off 10 of 15, on 5 of 16), once on the title before any click. The stall follows a Start click that enters play before the spawn chunk is built: every attempt whose first read after the click found the chunk built went on (20 of 20), 10 of the 11 that found it not yet built stalled, and 13 stalls never answered that read. While the page stalled, two Chromium processes grew to 15.6-15.8 GB of the runner's 16 GB in 6 of 12 jobs, and 5 runners were shut down, the end the two PR runs met. music-bus.spec.js now enters play the suite's way (the title entry passed 9 of 16 with the route on). Open: the title path on CI's software renderer, and whether a player on a real GPU who clicks Start before the world is built can meet it.
